page_title: AST 4-1 WHU | Aston Villa v West Ham 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The game is interrupted. Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

90+4' He should have scored! Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Emiliano Martinez makes an easy save.
90+3' A pass from Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola and the move breaks down.
90' Substitution. Pablo Fornals (West Ham) on for Michail Antonio.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' 4 - 1 Goal! Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the top left corner.
88' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
86' David Moyes has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danny Ings (West Ham) replacing Lucas Paqueta.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is coming onto the pitch as Moussa Diaby cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' The linesman signals that Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
83' The resulting corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is cleared by the defence.
82' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
80' Michail Antonio (West Ham) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
79' A pass into the penalty area from Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is intercepted by the defence.
76' Nicolo Zaniolo goes off the pitch and Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) comes on.

74' 3 - 1 Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Alphonse Areola is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 3:1.
74' Emiliano Martinez leaps to intercept the corner kick from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).
72' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

72' Michail Antonio (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' David Coote blows for a foul after Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Aston Villa in a dangerous position.
67' Tomas Soucek will be replaced by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham).
67' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
67' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
67' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
65' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared.
64' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
61' The game is interrupted now, Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
59' David Coote couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Emerson (West Ham) and blew his whistle. Free kick. Aston Villa will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
56' 2 - 1 Goal! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) shoots from distance and his effort takes a nick off the defender and goes past Emiliano Martinez. 2:1.
56' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alphonse Areola is well positioned and punches the ball away.
55' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
54' A yellow card for a tackle by Emerson (West Ham). David Coote doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
51' 2 - 0 Goal! Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alphonse Areola into middle of the goal.
51' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

50' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. David Coote blows his whistle for an infringement. PENALTY to Aston Villa! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
50' John McGinn (Aston Villa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

50' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa win a corner kick.

48' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and David Coote blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Aston Villa, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
42' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
41' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
40' The corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is hurriedly cleared.

39' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' John McGinn (Aston Villa) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
36' David Coote blows his whistle after James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Aston Villa earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
34' John McGinn (Aston Villa) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
33' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

33' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alphonse Areola with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
30' 1 - 0 Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
29' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
28' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but Alphonse Areola comes off his line to gather the ball.
28' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
28' Aston Villa will take a free kick near the side line. Rough tackle by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

24' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves David Coote with no other option than to blow for a foul. Aston Villa are awarded a free kick.
23' A pass from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola and the move breaks down.
22' Emerson (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
22' The resulting corner, taken by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa), comes to nothing.
22' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
21' John McGinn (Aston Villa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
20' A cross from Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
20' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
19' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) prepares to take a corner kick.

19' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
16' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
14' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez was alert and made a comfortable save.
13' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
12' John McGinn (Aston Villa) will take a corner kick.

12' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Alphonse Areola makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
12' The ball is cleared after Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
11' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) commits a rough challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to West Ham.
10' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
8' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
7' The free kick is taken by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa), but ball is cleared.
6' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham). David Coote saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.

5' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Aston Villa have a free kick.
5' Michail Antonio (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left David Coote no option but to blow his whistle.
2' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! West Ham will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be David Coote.
